name: volunteer-at-conferences
description: Get into a conference for free by working shifts or winning a travel grant or scholarship: track volunteer and grant windows, read real deadlines (including Anywhere-on-Earth), pick events by mission fit, prepare the application. Use when a conference is expensive or sold out. Triggers: "volunteer at a conference", "free conference entry", "conference scholarship", "travel grant". Not for press passes.
